attributes.board_name: Florida Board of Occupational Therapy Practice

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved providers listed in CE Broker; FOTA, AOTA and ACOTE-accredited program courses meeting the rule are approved. At least 14 hours live in person or interactive real-time; home study max 12 hours; video max 5 credits per subject. Up to 8 hours for presenting courses and attending Board meetings; up to 12 for Level II fieldwork or doctoral capstone supervision (0.5 h per week, max 6 per student); publications (book 10, chapter 5, peer-reviewed article 3, other article 1, editing a book 5); research (1 h per 10 h, max 5); volunteer expert witness (3 per case, max 6); pre-approved pro bono (1 h per 2 h, max 6).
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensed in the second half of the biennium: exempt from general hours but must complete 2 h medical errors and 1 h HIV/AIDS. Licensed in the first half: all 26 hours plus HIV/AIDS.
rules.audit_note: CE hours must be reported in the Department of Health tracking system (CE Broker) before the license can be renewed. Keep home-study validation forms 4 years.

topics.who: Board-approved provider; includes OT-specific medication indications/contraindications; counts toward the 26
Board-approved course on Chapters 456 and 468 Part III F.S. and Division 64B11 F.A.C.; counts toward the 26
No later than the first renewal; any DOH/MQA board-approved HIV/AIDS course
Board-approved 1-hour course required of OT licensees (part III, ch. 468) by Fla. Stat. §456.0341; deadline was Jan 1, 2021; counts toward total hours

rules.notes: 26 hours = 22 general + 2 medical errors + 2 laws and rules. Current licenses expire at midnight ET on February 28, 2027 (biennium March 1 – end of February, odd years). Rule effective 5/28/2024. The Board's renewal page lists only the medical errors, laws and rules, and first-renewal HIV/AIDS courses; the human-trafficking course comes from the statute.
rules.rule_quote: A minimum of fourteen (14) of the twenty-six (26) CE hours required for licensure renewal must be “live”.
